 Judgment
This appeal is filed by the insurance company questioning the liability fastened on it.

2. On 28.05.2009 at 3.30 p.m. near Corporation circle towards Civil Hospital in front of Veterinary Hospital at Dharwad while the deceased traveling as passenger in tempo bearing No.KA-34/C-2799 from Dharwad towards Dummawad, the vehicle was parked under the old banyan tree and due to heavy rain fall and wind, said banyan tree fallen on the parked tempo.
Due to which, the deceased who was inside the tempo died.
Therefore, claim petition is filed and tribunal has allowed the claim petition by granting compensation.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the material available on record.
4.

It is submitted by the counsel for the appellant that the tempo was parked under the banyan tree and at that time there was heavy rain and forceful wind and therefore NC: 2023:KHC-D:13339 to avoid this, the deceased has alighted the tempo and thereafter the banyan tree has fallen on the tempo and therefore, submitted that the vehicle was not in a movement and it was parked and hence, there is no motor vehicle accident.
Hence, claim petition is not maintainable.

Therefore,
prays to allow the appeal.
5. Admittedly, the vehicle was parked beneath the banyan tree.
The tempo was not in a moving state.
In the complaint-Ex.P1, it is stated that the deceased was travelling in the tempo and the tempo was parked beneath the banyan tree, since there was heavy rain and wind.
Therefore, just because the tempo was not in a movement state, there cannot be said that there was no motor vehicle accident.
The driver may not be rash and negligent but the fact remains proved that the deceased died while he was in the tempo due to fall of banyan tree on the tempo.
Therefore, it is nothing but a motor vehicle accident.

If the driver has taken care and has some diligence in parking the vehicle under the The Divisional Manager vs Ningappa S/O Gangappa Hubballi on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63755133/
3 tree and if he NC: 2023:KHC-D:13339 has verified whether it is safe to park the vehicle beneath the banyan tree he could have avoided the accident and without doing so, he has parked the tempo negligently under the banyan tree.

sentences.text: Therefore, even though the said act is because of force measures but also coupled with act of driver who had parked the vehicle under banyan tree.
Therefore, the claim petition is maintainable as it is found to be accident using the tempo.
Hence, entertaining the claim petition and granting compensation by the tribunal is just and proper, which needs no interference by this court 6.

Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal filed by the insurance company is dismissed.
ii) Amount in deposit is ordered to be transmitted to the tribunal along with TCR.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:13339 iii) No order as to costs.
iv) Draw decree accordingly.
